component.name: LobeHub
component.summary: Chief Agent Operator and AI agent workspace

description.p: LobeHub is an open-source AI Agent framework and desktop client supporting speech synthesis, multimodal reasoning, extensible plugins, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and heterogeneous CLI coding agents.
This Flatpak wraps the official Linux desktop build. The application package is downloaded directly from LobeHub's GitHub release distribution at install time.
